name: Taquile island walk
why: Across an island of stone terraces at 3,950 m, where the men knit and the textiles are UNESCO heritage, with the lake all around.
book: Boat tours from Puno port leave around 07:00-08:00 (2 h 30 each way, usually with a stop at the Uros islands). A S/10 fee is paid on landing.
water: Buy at the main square; carry 1 litre and sun cream.
dangers: Altitude: walk slowly, the climb from the port is steep at nearly 4,000 m.
Strong sun and cold wind on the lake.
turnaround: Be at the port your boat leaves from by the time your skipper gives: there is one boat back a day.

points.name: Puerto Salacancha
points.note: The landing on the east shore. The path climbs past terraces to the village.

points.name: Taquile main square
points.note: At 3,950 m, reached through a stone arch: the textile market hall and the tourist office that places lunch and homestays.

points.name: Mulsina Pata lookout
points.note: The highest point of the island, about 4,050 m, with the lake on every side.

points.name: Puerto Chillkano
points.note: Down a long stone staircase to the west landing, where boats wait.
